title: Simon's Good Day
synopsis: Simon, briefly himself again, spends a whole day doing the most ordinary things he can find and calls it the best day of his life.
plot:
For reasons nobody can explain, Simon wakes up one morning completely lucid, with no crown and no fog. Marceline, who has seen this happen before and seen it end, refuses to let him spend it on anything important. No research. No trying to fix things. Just a day.

Simon makes toast. He is amazed by toast. He goes to the old library and reads half a book about birds. He and Marceline sit on the porch of her house and she plays him a song and he gets the words wrong on purpose to make her laugh. Finn and Jake come by and Simon teaches Jake a card game that Jake is certain Simon is inventing as he goes, which he is.

As the sun goes down, Simon feels the fog coming back at the edges. He doesn't fight it. He tells Marceline it was the best day of his life, and that he means it, and that he'll forget, and that she shouldn't be sad about that because the day happened whether or not he remembers it. She writes it all down for him anyway. In the morning, Ice King finds a note in his pocket that says 'you had a good day' and, for some reason, believes it.
transcriptText:
Simon: Marcy? Marceline. I'm... I think I'm here.
Marceline: [very still] Simon?
Simon: How long do I have?
Marceline: I don't know. A day, maybe. Last time it was a day.
Simon: Then let's not waste it. I should get to the lab, there might be a way to—
Marceline: No.
Simon: No?
Marceline: No science. No fixing. You're gonna have a day, Simon. Just a day.
[The kitchen. Simon holds a slice of toast.]
Simon: It's warm. And it's crunchy. And it's bread. Marcy, this is incredible.
Marceline: It's toast.
Simon: It's TOAST.
[The old library. Simon reads.]
Simon: Did you know a swift can sleep while flying? It just... goes. For months.
Marceline: I didn't know that.
Simon: Neither did I. Isn't that something.
[Marceline's porch. She plays a song.]
Marceline: [singing] ...and the moon came down to—
Simon: [singing along, wrong] —and the SPOON came down to—
Marceline: [laughing] Simon!
Simon: What? That's how it goes.
[Finn and Jake arrive.]
Simon: Jake! Sit. I'll teach you a card game.
Jake: [ten minutes later] You're making these rules up.
Simon: Absolutely I am. Your turn. You have to draw three and apologize to the queen.
Jake: Which queen?
Simon: Any queen. Be sincere.
[Sunset. Simon's hands are trembling slightly.]
Simon: It's coming back.
Marceline: I know.
Simon: Marcy. Listen. This was the best day of my life. I mean that. And I'm going to forget it. And you shouldn't be sad about that. The day happened. It doesn't stop having happened.
Marceline: [writing on a scrap of paper] I'm gonna write it down anyway.
Simon: Good. Put in the part about the toast.
[Morning. Ice King finds a note in his pocket.]
Ice King: [reading] 'You had a good day.' ...Huh. Gunter, I think I had a good day.
Gunter: Wenk.
